title: Run-identity health endpoint
responsibility: Answer the supervisor's readiness question with an identity rather than a status: the service name, a versioned health protocol, the ephemeral run identifier of this invocation, the non-secret stable project identifier, and the build version — and nothing else, in particular no absolute path, no credential, and no session or planning content.
notes: ⚠️ EVERY FIELD IS THERE TO DEFEAT A SPECIFIC LOOKALIKE. The run id defeats a previous Kiln process still holding the port; the project id defeats a Kiln serving a different project; the service name and protocol defeat an unrelated application that happens to return JSON.
